title: Portfolio Execution Gates (1-3)
summary: Execute three concurrent portfolio gates: (1) Apply SEO/Geo/AEO to launch product, (2) Verify maintenance product stability, (3) Track feature development completion. Proven on Think Tank, JBH, Sekret-Bip.

gates.name: Product Launch — Apply SEO/Geo/AEO
gates.deliverable: Product ready for public launch with max SEO/Geo/AEO

gates.name: Product Maintenance — Verify Stability
gates.deliverable: Stability audit + continuation of maintenance cycle

success_criteria: Product 2 verified stable (security, CI/CD, no blockers)
Product 3 progressing toward completion (tests, commits, focus)
rollback: Each gate independent; git revert for Gate 1 if needed
reuse_for: Any portfolio with product at launch, maintenance, and feature-dev phases
Scaling founder-level oversight across multiple projects
next_gate: Monitor product 1 launch metrics (traffic, search, answer engines)
Drive product 3 to feature completion (tests, blockers)
